scope: Initial full application and cold-data restore acceptance for release 40. Cold model provisioning fixes have a separate source-specific validation.

host.base: Ubuntu 22.04 VM with an existing NVIDIA driver and no K3s

bootstrap.configuration: Separate private GitOps repository, read-only GitHub App; no public Argo CD API

cases.question: 動画によると、インターネットで「敵対的環境コース」を検索すると、何の住所が出てきますか？
cases.answer: 動画によると、インターネットで「敵対的環境コース」を検索すると、現地企業の住所が出てきます。

cases.question: According to the video, searching online for hostile environment courses will probably return whose addresses? Answer in English.
cases.answer: Searching online for hostile environment courses will probably return local company addresses.

cases.question: According to the video, what determines the color of cabbage juice? Answer in English.
cases.answer: The color of cabbage juice is determined by its acidity or alkalinity; it changes color depending on how acidic, basic, or alkaline the chemical is.

cases.question: 動画によると、キャベツの汁の色は何によって変わりますか？日本語で答えてください。
cases.answer: キャベツの汁の色は、酸性・塩基性・アルカリ性など、化学的なpHの状態によって変わります。

ui.tls: internal CA trusted; certificate verification enabled
ui.question: actual UI streamed chat
ui.answerText: Searching online for hostile environment courses will probably return the addresses of local companies. (0:01-0:08)

backupRestore.method: validated four-volume cold backup and restore
backupRestore.applicationAcceptanceAfterRestore: passed: JA/EN four-way cited answers and SSE; actual UI citation playback over verified HTTPS

initialIssues.driverUpdate: An unattended NVIDIA userspace update caused a driver/module mismatch; package processing stopped at its documented safe boundary, package audit passed, and the VM rebooted. Maintenance policy is PR 1396.
initialIssues.coldStart: The initial 600-second progress deadline and 1GiB downloader limit required recovery. PR 1398 records a separate empty-PVC download using two workers and a 4GiB limit.
